definition: The power to make decisions, or an official organization with that power
example_sentence: Local authorities closed the beach after the storm.

definition: A written legal agreement between people or organizations
example_sentence: The company signed a five-year contract with the city.

definition: To sell and send goods to another country
example_sentence: Israel exports advanced technology to many countries.

definition: The management of money, or the money needed for a project
example_sentence: The minister of finance presented the new budget.

definition: Work, especially physical work, or the people who do it
example_sentence: The factory moved to a country with cheaper labor.

definition: Allowed by law, or relating to the law
example_sentence: The legal age for voting is eighteen.

definition: One part in every hundred
example_sentence: Only ten percent of the participants dropped out.

definition: One of the parts that something is divided into
example_sentence: The second section of the report deals with costs.

definition: A part of the economy or of society
example_sentence: Jobs in the public sector are more secure.

definition: To help someone do something
example_sentence: Volunteers assisted the doctors during the emergency.

definition: One of the main parts of a book
example_sentence: The first chapter describes the history of the city.

definition: To use fuel, energy or time, or to eat or drink something
example_sentence: Air conditioners consume a lot of electricity.

definition: An arrangement to pay later, or praise for something done
example_sentence: The scientists received little credit for their discovery.

definition: To hurt a person or animal physically
example_sentence: Three workers were injured in the accident.

definition: To put money, time or effort into something to gain a benefit
example_sentence: The government invested heavily in public transport.

definition: A single thing in a list or collection
example_sentence: The survey included twenty items about daily habits.

definition: A serious magazine about a subject, or a written daily record
example_sentence: The study was published in a leading medical journal.

definition: To take part in an activity or event
example_sentence: More than five hundred students participated in the study.

definition: To buy something
example_sentence: Most customers now purchase tickets online.

definition: A set of different things of the same type, or the limits within which something varies
example_sentence: The shop sells a wide range of products.

definition: To limit the amount, size or range of something
example_sentence: The new law restricts the use of plastic bags.

definition: Safe and protected, or not likely to change or fail
example_sentence: Workers want secure jobs with a fair salary.

definition: A place where something is, was or will be
example_sentence: The site of the new hospital has not been chosen.

definition: A set of questions asked to many people to learn their opinions or habits
example_sentence: A national survey found that most people read less than before.

definition: Written words, especially in a book or document
example_sentence: Students must read the text carefully before answering.

definition: Something you say or write that gives an opinion
example_sentence: The minister refused to make any comment.

definition: Happening all the time, or staying the same
example_sentence: The machine needs constant attention.

definition: The central or most important part of something
example_sentence: Reading is at the core of the program.

definition: To match or be similar to something, or to exchange letters
example_sentence: The results correspond closely to earlier findings.

definition: An amount of money saved or collected for a purpose
example_sentence: The school raised funds for a new library.

definition: The process of coming to live in a new country
example_sentence: Immigration has changed the character of the city.

definition: A level of material that lies over or under something else
example_sentence: A thin layer of ice covered the lake.

definition: A connection between two or more things
example_sentence: Researchers found a link between diet and heart disease.

definition: To find the exact position of something, or to put it in a place
example_sentence: The factory is located near the port.

definition: To make something as large or effective as possible
example_sentence: Farmers use new methods to maximize their crops.

definition: Small or not very important
example_sentence: The changes to the plan were minor.

definition: A person or organization you work or live with
example_sentence: The two companies became partners in the project.

definition: To behave in a particular way because of something that happens
example_sentence: Markets reacted quickly to the news.

definition: To put your name on an official list
example_sentence: All students must register for classes by Friday.

definition: A change in position or direction, or a period of work
example_sentence: There has been a shift in public opinion.

definition: The right or opportunity to use or reach something
example_sentence: Millions of people still lack access to clean water.

definition: Happening once a year
example_sentence: The annual report shows a rise in profits.

definition: The way you think or feel about something
example_sentence: Attitudes toward women in the workplace have changed.

definition: To do something wrong or illegal, or to promise to do something
example_sentence: The country committed to cutting emissions by half.

definition: A series of events that repeat in the same order
example_sentence: The life cycle of the insect lasts only a few weeks.

definition: A discussion in which people express different opinions
example_sentence: The plan caused a heated debate in parliament.

definition: Relating to the home, or to your own country
example_sentence: Domestic flights are cheaper than international ones.

definition: Inside something, such as a body, organization or country
example_sentence: The company started an internal investigation.

definition: The amount of something produced
example_sentence: Factory output rose by five percent.

definition: A stage in a process of change or development
example_sentence: The first phase of the project is complete.

definition: A planned piece of work with a particular purpose
example_sentence: The project aims to improve reading skills.

definition: A number of similar things that come one after another
example_sentence: The study includes a series of interviews.

definition: The social or legal position of someone, or the situation at a time
example_sentence: Education is often linked to social status.

definition: Worry caused by a difficult situation, or special importance
example_sentence: Stress can weaken the immune system.
